ios.desc:
Receipt Box is a personal finance app for spending tracking. It is a fast tool that can ensure that you develop the habit of tracking spending.

No need to register, Data is stored in iPhone & iCloud
Data can be exported
Backup and Restore
Auto Backup to iCloud Drive
Password or biometrics available

Add categories
Add tags
Add note
Modify date
Installment
Preset key

Finance overview on daily, monthly, yearly and customize range
Set the starting day of the monthly financial overview
Category statistics times and times avg
Search function
Tag index
Change UI color
Dark night mode

The app contains an yearly subscription that enjoy the Pro features and support future development.Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of current period.Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://receiptbox2013.wordpress.com/privacy/

Support mail:
receiptbox2013@outlook.com

quotes.text:
I don't know if the app was originally free with in-app-purchases when the author obtained it, but it currently is:

https://apps.apple.com/au/app/receipt-box-spending-tracker/id627878792#?platform=iphone

The same developer appears to offer a "Pro" version of their app with no in-app purchases or subscriptions. It is priced around $20:

https://apps.apple.com/au/app/receipt-box-pro/id1289911732#?platform=iphone

I would assume that this Pro version is intended to be completely unlocked all the time, while the free version is being monetized and directed towards people who want to try something but aren't dedicated users

(Although I don't understand why they don't simply have the "Pro" version be a $20 once-off in-app-purchase in the free app bundle)
